canonical_title: Pressure venting and drainage of rotor blades

versions.title_at_revision: Pressure venting and drainage of rotor blades
versions.text:
(a) For each rotor blade:
  (1) There m ust be m eans for venting the internal pressure of the blade;
  (2) Drainage holes m ust be provided for the blade; and
  (3) The blade must be designed to prevent water from becoming trapped in it.
(b) Sub-paragraphs (a)(1) and (2) do not apply to sealed rotor blades capable of withstanding the maximum pressure differentials expected in service.
